backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the NFS Mods Hub backend, implementing mod upload, retrieval, listing, download count tracking, and admin-only deletion, with authorization and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two neon glow styling features (navbar branding and site-wide accent elements) to their affected frontend files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the NFS Mods Hub React application.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH CSS custom property color tokens for both light and dark themes used by shadcn-ui components.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting the page title to 'NFS Mods Hub' and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for the mod listing, upload, detail, and My Mods pages, all wrapped in a shared Layout and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Sticky navigation bar component featuring neon-pulse branded logo, authenticated nav links (Browse Mods, My Mods), and login/logout/upload action buttons with neon glow styling.
frontend/src/components/ModCard.tsx: Reusable mod card component displaying a preview image, category badge, title, description, game tag, and metadata footer, with neon border glow and title glow on hover.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP actor using TanStack Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via an AuthClient wrapper.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for backend actor interactions including listing, fetching, uploading, deleting mods, and incrementing download counts.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, and defines a dark racing-themed design system with OKLCH CSS custom properties and neon utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/ModDetailPage.tsx: Page component that displays full details of a single mod by ID, including preview image, metadata stats, and a download button that increments the download count.
frontend/src/pages/ModListingPage.tsx: Page component showing a searchable, filterable grid of all mods with a hero banner, category/game filters, and navigation to upload or view individual mods.
frontend/src/pages/ModUploadPage.tsx: Page component providing a form for authenticated users to upload a new mod, including file selection, preview image, metadata fields, validation, and Internet Identity login gating.
frontend/src/pages/MyModsPage.tsx: A React page that displays the authenticated user's uploaded mods in a list with metadata (game, date, downloads, file size), and allows deleting mods via a confirmation dialog. Redirects unauthenticated users to log in via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with helpers to persist values in sessionStorage and clean sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a dark racing-themed design system with neon yellow-green accent colors, custom fonts (Barlow Condensed, Inter), neon glow box shadows, and extended color tokens using OKLCH variables.
project_state.json: Project state manifest tracking the current version, feature list, and architectural notes for a Need for Speed mod-sharing website with Internet Identity authentication and ICP backend.
